what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Rwanda in Malawi: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4233 Rwandan asylum seekers in Malawi, 20.9% of all asylum seekers from Rwanda.
Refugees from Rwanda, a separate group, live mostly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, France and Malawi.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda in periods from 1997 to 2025, most recently with FDLR-FOCA.
The main years of displacement in the data include 2018 to 2025, which overlap the later periods of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 6800 asylum seekers.
It fell to a low in 2004 and then rose again.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malawi.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Malawi only.
